title: Hyperliquid Co-founder Jeff Yan says 24-hour clock is not onchain finance’s true differentiator
summary: Hyperliquid (HYPE) Co-founder Jeff Yan said at Korea Blockchain Week that around-the-clock trading is not what sets onchain venues apart from traditional exchanges.
